The '''Chagrian courts''' was a court system utilized by the [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] [[Species/Legends|people]]. The courts were believed to some of the most fair and balanced in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], leading to brief trials as most Chagrians admitted their guilt.<ref name="LBE" />
